implementation: Viewer opens a smaller scene-linear HDR level when full texture/current visible region cannot fit
Level dimensions are repeatedly halved until managed CPU output and current GPU texture/queue headroom admit a candidate
App LOD cache budget16MiB is a child of configured managed CPU root; independently managed when no root is configured
Managed source and one filtered level are retained without copying original pixels
View refresh reuses preview/exposure state, promotes to exact source region when admitted, and returns to cached preview on zoom-out
When cached preview exceeds replacement headroom, create/admit a smaller level before replacing old cache/frame
Original and preview both preserve pixel aspect, alpha-aware HDR and RAW monotone curve
Texture/queue planning query is advisory; actual upload reservations still enforce admission

checks: Exposure-only and unchanged fit do not upload
Zoom/pan source regions match whole-source reference frames
Return to fit matches cached LOD reference, no re-filter
Under20000 bytes GPU headroom cached40960-byte LOD is replaced by10240-byte level
External old preview owner remains charged during replacement

native_window.surface_scope: Native window, actual Metal adapter, requested HDR surface; no physical luminance/color measurement

limits: Filtering/uploads are synchronous on current viewer thread; background cancellation/scheduling still open
Full CPU source remains retained; no out-of-core region decoder
One retained preview plus one current texture region; no multiregion LRU or overscan prefetch
Halving sizes is conservative, and preview quality can stay reduced until source-region replacement has headroom
Shared-ancestor/concurrent headroom can invalidate planning query; final atomic admission may refuse safely
Authored/native controls do not establish full100-format acceptance
Physical HDR accuracy, NVIDIA and physically slow-disk qualification remain open
